postman.com.company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies the entire API lifecycle, enabling developers to build, test, and manage APIs more efficiently. Founded by Abhinav Asthana, Ankit Sobti, and Abhijit Kane, it has become the world's leading API platform.
postman.com.target_audience: Developers, API teams, and enterprises looking to build, test, and manage APIs.

supabase.com.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source, Postgres‑based developer platform that provides authentication, realtime, storage, RESTful APIs, and edge functions. It is built by developers for developers and supports building production‑ready applications.
supabase.com.target_audience: Developers, startups, enterprises, and innovation teams building applications on Postgres.

vapi.ai.company_overview: Vapi is a voice AI platform that enables developers to build, deploy, and improve voice agents quickly, with enterprise‑grade scalability and compliance. It targets enterprises and developers across industries such as healthcare, automotive, staffing, and marketplaces.
vapi.ai.target_audience: Enterprise customers and developers building voice AI agents across industries such as healthcare, automotive, staffing, and marketplaces.
